title: Audit cleanup, Rust render logic, motorcycle races and Garage stats
summary: Combined three paused workstreams into one checkpoint: the code audit cleanup, render-frame logic moved from JavaScript into Rust, motorcycles racing the original CPU roster, and original ATV stats in the renamed Garage.
details: Vegetation selection, terrain height for cameras, race starts and PSM material parsing now run in Rust; JavaScript only uploads buffers and issues draws.
Crash mode and chase camera default to the recovered original behaviour.
Browser tests share one harness, are classified in a manifest, and a content-free smoke group runs in CI. The disabled experimental release queue was removed.
A motorcycle player now races the original CPU roster on physical ATVs, uses ATV2's original follow and wreck cameras, and gets the original map-edge launch.
The Garage shows Engine, Traction and Suspension from the original uiQuad.txt, the maker logo, and the authored top speed. The top quad really is rated 1.0 on all three.
The Quad and Rider entry is now called Garage; the Rider Gear page no longer puts Back over its last rows on shorter phones.

Verified on host: make check, make web, the content-free smoke group, race (ATV and motorcycle), two race courses, vegetation billboards and materials, fog, frontend, menu models, motorcycle menu and UI polish browser tests.
limitation: Music not playing on the public site has not been investigated.
